description: Sets up a practice job interview for the signed-in user and returns a LINK to it. The interview happens on Foundaree as a face-to-face video call with Asha, Foundaree's AI interviewer: she asks about 4 real field questions plus questions about lines on their CV, out loud, and the user simply talks. Needs a CV report id (from upload_cv, build_cv or my_cv_reports). Give the user the link and tell them to open it on a phone or laptop with a camera and microphone. Do NOT ask the interview questions in this chat. When they come back, call interview_report to go through their results.

cv_report_id.description: The CV report to ask about.

role.description: The role they are practising for, e.g. "Backend developer".

name: start_mock_interview
title: Set up a video mock interview from a CV
